decisions.reason: As a prominently announced new product line closely tied to the firm's core software direction, management is likely to stay committed and view any early difficulties as temporary.
Although the public commitment seems weaker, it builds on the firm's training capabilities and customer relationships, so management would likely continue it rather than reverse course quickly.

Because it directly supports the established software and service business, management is likely to retain it and justify continued investment as part of better customer support and digital connectivity.
